correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the finite two-branch geometric sum A_g(ell,k) = r^{-ell}(1-r^N)(r^{2ell}omega^{kell}+r^N)/(1-r²omega^k), proving only even half-shift/odd-modulation zeros. Fourier diagonalization gives exactly m Weyl matrix null modes and Hermitian skew-antipodal blocks. Disjoint 2x2 blocks have rank 2s, hence every nonzero rank<=2 ambiguity has support on one pair. A new rank-one projector separates that pair iff its imaginary antipodal coefficient is nonzero; spectral decomposition of any unseparated traceless block constructs two inequivalent signals with equal all intensities. This proves both directions globally for all even N>=2 and every r in (0,1), with odd full-rank boundary. Independent numerical Gabor/projector SVD and explicit witnesses were checked for N=2..12 at r=.3,.5,.8 (33 parameter combinations). Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
